sources.filmMetadata: Dossier's bundled BestSimilar film catalogue, matched by normalized title and exact release year
sources.licenseNote: MovieLens permits research use and redistribution under its stated conditions. Acknowledge GroupLens; do not imply endorsement. Commercial use requires its permission.

selection.viewerRule: At least 150 matched ratings, 40 clear likes (4+ stars), and 40 clear dislikes (2.5 stars or less). Include every qualifying viewer.
selection.heldOutRule: 60 rated films per viewer: reserve 12 clear likes and 12 clear dislikes, then take 36 more by fixed hash order.
selection.otherViewerMean: A simple reference score from other MovieLens viewers. It subtracts this viewer's rating and shrinks sparse films toward 3.5 stars with ten prior ratings. Dossier does not get these scores.
selection.genreTranslation: Translate Sci-Fi to Science Fiction and Musical to Music for Dossier's genre vocabulary. Preserve all other source labels.
selection.caveat: The evaluation can score only films a viewer chose to rate. These rated films are not a random sample of all films. Film metadata lacks director and series fields.

methods.primary: Mean held-out AUC across viewers and four training orders. Clear likes are 4+ stars and clear dislikes are 2.5 stars or less; 3 and 3.5 stars are neutral.
methods.top10: Share of the first ten suggested films that this viewer clearly liked. Compare with that viewer's held-out like share.
methods.training: Only selected training ratings cross the CLI rate.set boundary. Held-out ratings and MovieLens identity stay in the evaluator.
methods.baselines: Public film rating, public popularity, genre, average lens vector, nearest liked film, other-viewer mean, and random ranking. Other-viewer mean has extra information unavailable to Dossier.
methods.limitations: The evaluation can score only films a viewer chose to rate. These rated films are not a random sample of all films. Film metadata lacks director and series fields.

componentDefinitions.no_groups: Same ranking, keeping each rated film separate
componentDefinitions.no_groups_no_claims: Separate rated films, without inferred claims
componentDefinitions.no_dislike_penalty: Same ranking, without the style penalty for disliked films; negative claims still apply
componentDefinitions.no_negative_signals: Use liked films and positive claims only
componentDefinitions.quality_priority: Same ranking, with public review scores given more weight (1 instead of 0.05)
componentDefinitions.quality_plus_similarity: 75% public review score, 25% nearest rated-film style score
componentDefinitions.metadata_similarity: Match genre and keyword tags directly, without Dossier’s style representation
componentDefinitions.quality_plus_metadata: 75% public review score, 25% direct genre and keyword matching

sources.filmMetadata: TMDB full detail, through the same TmdbClient used by Dossier. IDs come from the pinned MovieLens links.csv.
sources.licenseNote: MovieLens permits research use and redistribution under its stated conditions. Acknowledge GroupLens; do not imply endorsement. Commercial use requires its permission.

tmdb.attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

selection.viewerRule: At least 150 matched ratings, 40 clear likes (4+ stars), and 40 clear dislikes (2.5 stars or less). Include every qualifying viewer.
selection.heldOutRule: 60 rated films per viewer: reserve 12 clear likes and 12 clear dislikes, then take 36 more by fixed hash order.
selection.otherViewerMean: A simple reference score from other MovieLens viewers. It subtracts this viewer's rating and shrinks sparse films toward 3.5 stars with ten prior ratings. Dossier does not get these scores.
selection.genreTranslation: Translate Sci-Fi to Science Fiction and Musical to Music for Dossier's genre vocabulary. Preserve all other source labels.
selection.caveat: The evaluation can score only films a viewer chose to rate. These rated films are not a random sample of all films. Candidate retrieval is not evaluated.
selection.identity: Keep evaluator film keys unchanged to preserve the exact viewer splits and training order. Actual TMDB IDs remain in public source metadata.

selection.tvException: Band of Brothers is a TV miniseries in TMDB. Use its full TV detail while keeping the original evaluator film key. It appears only in viewer 414 training candidates, never in hidden answers.

methods.primary: Mean held-out AUC across viewers and four training orders. Clear likes are 4+ stars and clear dislikes are 2.5 stars or less; 3 and 3.5 stars are neutral.
methods.top10: Share of the first ten suggested films that this viewer clearly liked. Compare with that viewer's held-out like share.
methods.training: Only selected training ratings cross the CLI rate.set boundary. Held-out ratings and MovieLens identity stay in the evaluator.
methods.baselines: Public film rating, public popularity, genre, average lens vector, nearest liked film, other-viewer mean, and random ranking. Other-viewer mean has extra information unavailable to Dossier.
methods.limitations: The evaluation can score only films a viewer chose to rate. These rated films are not a random sample of all films. Candidate retrieval is not evaluated.

componentDefinitions.no_groups: Same ranking, keeping each rated film separate
componentDefinitions.no_groups_no_claims: Separate rated films, without inferred claims
componentDefinitions.no_dislike_penalty: Same ranking, without the style penalty for disliked films; negative claims still apply
componentDefinitions.no_negative_signals: Use liked films and positive claims only
componentDefinitions.quality_priority: Same ranking, with public review scores given more weight (1 instead of 0.05)
componentDefinitions.quality_plus_similarity: 75% public review score, 25% nearest rated-film style score
componentDefinitions.metadata_similarity: Match genre and keyword tags directly, without Dossier’s style representation
componentDefinitions.quality_plus_metadata: 75% public review score, 25% direct genre and keyword matching
